The one-step IID mean-square map q||e||^2+eta^2 delta^2, q=1-eta+eta^2/2, iterates to c_I=q^3 and d_I=eta^2 delta^2(1+q+q^2). Independent explicit symbolic multiplication of all six RR affine permutation maps confirmed E[M^T M]=c_R I and E[M^T v]=0, with c_R=1-3eta+3eta^2-eta^3+eta^6/32 and d_R=eta^4 delta^2(eta^2+6eta+12)/16. Symbolic factorization confirms c_R-c_I=-3eta^2(2-eta)^4/32. Positive-coordinate polynomial transforms and Descartes rule give unique quartic eta1=1.1803110213; monotone cubic eta_inf=1.2126391135 gives stationary sign threshold. The real-epoch geometric ratio decreases, establishing exactly one transient reversal window eta1<eta<eta_inf from e0=0; at eta=6/5 first RR worse then eventually better. General starts only enjoy universal RR dominance at eta<=eta1. The finite path examples are not relied on for all eta or k.
